problem: Describe the ruler-and-compass construction of the perpendicular bisector of XY.
solution: Draw equal-radius arcs from X and Y above and below the segment; join their two intersection points. The joining line bisects XY at its midpoint and is perpendicular to XY.
reasoning: These are the construction steps developed in the chapter.

problem: Describe how to copy an angle using only ruler and compass.
solution: Draw an arc across the original angle; reproduce the same arc at the new vertex; transfer the chord length between the original arc intersections to the new arc; join the new point to the vertex.
reasoning: The chapter proves the copied triangles congruent by SSS, so the angles are equal.
